clue.text: Run in a straight line

definitions.meaning: to run a business or campaign is to manage or steer it
going straight, without detours or deviation

explanation.surface: An instruction for how to sprint: keep in a straight line.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb the word means manage or steer; as an adjective it means straight, with no detour.

clue.text: Heartlessly pay dole in new way -spread out

indicators.note: set out in a new way means the letters are reordered
heartlessly says the middle letter of pay is removed

explanation.surface: Benefit paid in a new way without compassion is spread around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heartlessly' cuts PAY to PY; 'in new way' rearranges PY with DOLE.
explanation.definitionFit: To deploy troops is to spread them out into position.

clue.text: Song sequence about love put off

indicators.note: about means the sequence word goes round the love word

parts.note: a run is a sequence, as of cards
love is nil in tennis, the letter O
to delay is to put off

explanation.surface: A song cycle about love has been postponed.
explanation.definitionFit: A roundelay is a short simple song with a refrain.

clue.text: Clubs get beaten in the end

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for clubs in card games
to lose is to get beaten

explanation.surface: A card player with clubs ends up beaten.
explanation.definitionFit: A close is a conclusion, as in the close of play.

clue.text: Continental community still over the moon

parts.note: EC is the European Community, a community on the Continent
still means motionless, static

explanation.surface: A European community that is still delighted.
explanation.definitionFit: Over the moon is an idiom for thrilled, overjoyed.

clue.text: React violently to pander

indicators.note: violently signals the letters are thrown about into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone responds angrily to being pandered to.
explanation.definitionFit: To pander to people is to indulge or provide for their wishes.

clue.text: Country's temperature the man reports

definitions.note: read as 'Country is', the 's a link

parts.note: he is the man
states means reports, declares

explanation.surface: A country's temperature is announced by a man.
explanation.definitionFit: The USA is the nation commonly called this, a single country.

clue.text: Bird -an enormous creature

parts.note: a tit is a small bird

explanation.surface: A small bird and an enormous one are set side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: A titan is a giant, from the Greek mythological race of giants.

clue.text: Talk? Just the opposite

definitions.meaning: to talk with someone, to chat

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether to talk, then says the opposite.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means chat; as a noun it means the reverse of something.

clue.text: Fancy needlework covering tail of shirt

indicators.note: covering means the needlework word wraps around the letter

parts.note: crochet is needlework done with a hook

indicators.note: tail of means the last letter of shirt

explanation.surface: Elaborate needlework covers the bottom of a shirt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fancy' reads as an adjective on needlework but is the definition, a whim.
explanation.definitionFit: A crotchet is an old word for a whim or odd notion, a fancy.

clue.text: Fat cat apt to curl in a strange way

indicators.note: letters arranged in a strange way are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A rich man described as being likely to curl up oddly.
explanation.definitionFit: A fat cat is slang for a rich, powerful person, one who rules by wealth.

clue.text: Some meat enjoyed like this?

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A question about how some meat was enjoyed.
explanation.definitionFit: Meat that has been enjoyed has been consumed, so the clue's 'like this' points at food finished off.

clue.text: Leftover old insecticide overcomes people

indicators.note: the insecticide word comes over and around the people word, enclosing it

parts.note: DDT is a well-known insecticide
men means people

explanation.surface: Some old insecticide left over gets the better of the people using it.
explanation.definitionFit: A remnant or scrap left behind is an odd piece remaining after the rest is used.

clue.text: Followers always holding one back

indicators.note: back says the whole assembled string is read from right to left
holding means the always word grips the one word inside it

parts.note: e'er is a poetic contraction of ever, always
a unit is one single thing

explanation.surface: Loyal followers always keep one in reserve.
explanation.walkthrough: E'ER is the poetic contraction of ever; 'back' turns round the whole assembled string, not just one piece.
explanation.definitionFit: A retinue is the band of attendants who follow an important person.

clue.text: Try something desperate — as greedy suckers do?

definitions.meaning: an idiom for grabbing at any slim chance when desperate
drinkers sucking greedily literally grab at the drinking tubes

explanation.surface: Someone desperate is compared to a greedy drinker.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes making a desperate attempt at anything; literally, greedy drinkers grip their drinking tubes.

clue.text: Aggressive exchange you reported fast

indicators.note: reported means spoken aloud, the words heard rather than written

parts.note: truck means exchange or barter, and you is heard as U
Lent is the Christian season of fasting

explanation.surface: A hostile exchange is quickly reported.
explanation.definitionFit: Truculent means eager to fight, belligerent.

clue.text: Actors of limited range may be of two sorts

definitions.text: Actors of limited range may be

parts.note: type means sort
cast means sort, as in 'a cast of mind'

explanation.surface: Actors with narrow range come in two kinds.
explanation.definitionFit: Performers always given the same kind of role are stuck in a rut of character.

clue.text: Wicked actor somehow promises to settle scores

indicators.note: somehow says the letters are put together in some other order

parts.note: IOUs are notes promising to pay debts

explanation.surface: A villainous actor promises to settle old grudges.
explanation.walkthrough: 'somehow' rearranges ACTOR into ATROC; scores are debts, not grudges.
explanation.definitionFit: Atrocious means extremely wicked or cruel.

clue.text: Steal Jack's territory

parts.note: a jack is a sailor, AB for able seaman, plus the 's
a tract is an area of territory

explanation.surface: A man named Jack's land is taken.
explanation.definitionFit: To abstract something is to remove it, often dishonestly, to purloin.

clue.text: Sexy beauty with part to play in historical record

indicators.note: the letters are given room to play, moving into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: An attractive actor gets a part in a history drama.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to play' rearranges the letters of SEXY BEAUTY and PART together; 'with' just joins them.
explanation.definitionFit: The Bayeux Tapestry is an embroidered account of the Norman Conquest of 1066, a record of history.

clue.text: The old leading man comes around — he shows persistence

indicators.note: comes around means the leading man word surrounds the old word

parts.note: the star is the leading man
ye is an old form of the

explanation.surface: An old star makes a comeback, showing persistence.
explanation.definitionFit: A stayer is someone or something with endurance, as a horse lasting a long race.

clue.text: Having completed short time in firm

indicators.note: in places the short time inside the word for firm

parts.note: tough means firm, hard
hr is the short form of hour

explanation.surface: Someone has finished a short stint working at a company.
explanation.definitionFit: Being finished with something means having completed it, as in 'I'm done'.

clue.text: One gets up part of flight

definitions.meaning: the vertical piece of a stair in a flight of steps

explanation.surface: Someone getting up for part of a journey by air.
explanation.definitionFit: It means someone who rises, and the upright part of a step in a staircase.

clue.text: Enable old husband to get put up in accommodation

indicators.note: put up means raised, read upwards in a down entry

parts.note: let means allow, enable

explanation.surface: An elderly husband is allowed to stay somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put up' reverses LETOH, read upwards in this down light; it looks like the lodging sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A hotel is a building offering rooms for guests.

clue.text: Catch unknown creature — a parrot

parts.note: to cop is slang for to catch
y is an algebraic unknown
a cat is a creature

explanation.surface: Trying to catch a mystery animal that turns out to be a parrot.
explanation.definitionFit: A parrot, figuratively, is someone who mimics others, an imitator.

clue.text: Soldier, without fuel, sent North on horse

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, enclosing the fuel
sent North means reversed, read upwards in a down clue

parts.note: up means mounted on a horse, as in a jockey being up
oil is fuel

explanation.surface: A soldier with no fuel is sent north on horseback.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' carries its old sense of outside, not lacking; a jockey mounted is said to be 'up', which 'sent North' turns round in this down light.
explanation.definitionFit: A poilu is a French infantryman, especially of the First World War.

clue.text: Liquor is found inside part of supermarket

indicators.note: found inside means the word is sits within the liquor word

parts.note: ale is a liquor, a brewed drink

explanation.surface: The drink is stocked in a particular section of the supermarket.
explanation.definitionFit: Supermarket shelving is laid out along passageways down which shoppers walk.

clue.text: In bad-tempered case, I am willing to appear as witness

indicators.note: case means the bad-tempered word forms a casing around the rest

parts.note: testy means irritable, bad-tempered
I'm is the contraction of I am
on means willing, game, as in 'I'm on'

explanation.surface: An irritable person agrees to testify in a court case.
explanation.definitionFit: Testimony is evidence, the account a person gives when they bear witness.

clue.text: Choke — one of car's controls

definitions.meaning: to choke someone is to strangle them
the pedal or lever regulating fuel flow to an engine

explanation.surface: A choke on a car is described as one of its controls.
explanation.definitionFit: It means to strangle, and also the valve that governs engine speed by fuel supply.

clue.text: Soldier discovering fish by a river

parts.note: huss is a name for dogfish sold in British fish shops

explanation.surface: A soldier finds fish beside a river.
explanation.walkthrough: HUSS is dogfish as sold in British chip shops; 'discovering' only joins definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A hussar is a light cavalryman, a kind of soldier.
